SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Elections in Kenya, part of Themes in Kenyan History and Citizenship in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why are elections important? 2. Which values can citizens embrace to avoid election malpractices?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
